/**
 * @file draw-text/fluid.ts — liquid-distortion warp for <draw-text warp>.
 *
 * Replaces the decorative per-char warp with a real fluid simulation:
 * the finished title is rasterized to a texture and drawn on a WebGL
 * quad whose pixels are displaced by a divergence-free velocity field —
 * the text behaves like ink printed on the surface of a stirred liquid.
 *
 * The solver is a compact stable-fluids pipeline (GPU Gems ch. 38),
 * run every frame on a low-res grid in UNSIGNED_BYTE targets so it
 * works on every WebGL1 context (no float-FBO extension needed):
 *
 *   advect   — semi-Lagrangian self-transport + viscous damping
 *   splat    — gaussian impulses: pointer motion + two orbiting ambient
 *              stirrers so the surface breathes without interaction
 *   vorticity— curl field → confinement force (keeps small swirls alive)
 *   project  — divergence → ~16 Jacobi pressure iterations → gradient
 *              subtract, making the flow incompressible (real physics:
 *              fluid can't pile up, it swirls around obstacles)
 *   display  — text texture sampled at uv − v·k with a subtle chromatic
 *              fringe proportional to local displacement
 *
 * Velocity/scalar channels are signed values remapped into [0,1] bytes
 * (ENC_SCALE) — 8-bit resolution is plenty for a displacement field.
 * The DOM char spans stay mounted (a11y + fallback) and are hidden via
 * the draw-text--fluid class; on any GL failure the caller falls back
 * to the char-transform warp.
 */
 
import { ARIA_ATTRS } from '@core/tokens/attrs/aria.js'
import { COMMON_ATTRS } from '@core/tokens/attrs/common.js'
import { ATTR_VALUES } from '@core/tokens/attrs/values.js'
import { POINTER_EVENTS } from '@core/tokens/events/dom.js'
import { GL_EVENTS } from '@core/tokens/events/dom.js'
import { TYPE_STRINGS } from '@core/tokens/strings/types.js'
import { DRAW_TEXT_SELECTORS } from '@core/tokens/selectors/draw-text.js'
import { DRAW_TEXT_CLASSES } from '@core/tokens/classes/draw-text.js'
import { HTML_TAGS } from '@core/tokens/elements/html.js'
import { createQuadProgram, bindQuad } from '@core/utils/canvas/gl-program.js'
import { webglContext } from '@core/utils/canvas/webgl-mode.js'
import { devWarn } from '@core/devlog.js'
import store from '@core/store.js'
import type { DrawText } from '../DrawText.js'
 
// ── Tunables (fractions of host geometry — size-agnostic like warp.ts) ──
 
/** Field grid height cap in cells (width follows the canvas aspect). */
const _SIM_H = 56
/** Field grid width cap — wide titles get proportionally more columns. */
const _SIM_W = 192
/** Canvas padding around the text box — displaced pixels may bleed out. */
const _PAD_RATIO = 0.45
/** Min canvas padding in px (tiny labels still get bleed room). */
const _PAD_MIN = 10
/** Signed field range mapped into byte textures (uv/s + unit scalars). */
const _ENC_SCALE = 1.6
/** Velocity damping per second — viscous decay of the stirred field. */
const _DAMP_PER_S = 1.35
/** Vorticity confinement strength — swirl energy fed back per step. */
const _VORTICITY = 4.0
/** Jacobi pressure iterations per frame — incompressibility accuracy. */
const _JACOBI = 16
/** Pointer splat radius, fraction of the smaller canvas dimension. */
const _SPLAT_R = 0.16
/** Pointer impulse gain — pointer uv/s → injected field velocity. */
const _SPLAT_GAIN = 0.55
/** Ambient stirrer orbit radius, fraction of the smaller dimension. */
const _STIR_ORBIT = 0.3
/** Ambient stirrer angular speed (rad/s) — slow drift, not a whirlpool. */
const _STIR_OMEGA = 0.45
/** Ambient stirrer injection strength (field units/s). */
const _STIR_FORCE = 0.35
/** Displacement scale — field velocity → uv offset on the text pass. */
const _DISP = 0.12
/** Chromatic fringe — fraction of the displacement split across channels. */
const _FRINGE = 0.045
/** Max devicePixelRatio for the text snapshot (retina sharpness, bounded). */
const _DPR_CAP = 2
/** Cap on the offscreen text canvas edge (texture memory bound). */
const _SNAP_MAX = 2048
/** Poll cap (frames) waiting for the reveal to finish before arming. */
const _ARM_POLL_MAX = 900
 
// ── Shaders (GLSL ES 1.00 — WebGL1) ─────────────────────────────────────
 
/** Shared quad vertex shader — uv space is screen-like: v=0 at the top. */
const VS = `
attribute vec2 a_pos;
varying vec2 v_uv;
void main() {
  v_uv = vec2(0.5 + 0.5 * a_pos.x, 0.5 - 0.5 * a_pos.y);
  gl_Position = vec4(a_pos, 0.0, 1.0);
}
`
 
/** Shared field helpers — byte-encode signed values into texel channels. */
const FIELD_GLSL = `
vec2 decV(vec4 c) { return (c.rg - 0.5) * ${(2 * _ENC_SCALE).toFixed(2)}; }
vec4 encV(vec2 v) { return vec4(clamp(v / ${(2 * _ENC_SCALE).toFixed(2)} + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0); }
float decS(vec4 c) { return (c.r - 0.5) * 2.0; }
vec4 encS(float s) { return vec4(clamp(s * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0), 0.0, 0.0, 1.0); }
`
 
/**
 * Gaussian impulse — adds `u_value` into the velocity field around
 * `u_point`; `u_ar` rounds the splat in the canvas's aspect so the
 * injected eddy is circular in screen space, not in stretched uv space.
 */
const FS_SPLAT = `
precision mediump float;
varying vec2 v_uv;
uniform sampler2D u_tex;
uniform vec2 u_point;
uniform vec2 u_value;
uniform float u_radius;
uniform float u_ar;
${FIELD_GLSL}
void main() {
  vec2 p = v_uv - u_point;
  p.x *= u_ar;
  float g = exp(-dot(p, p) / u_radius);
  gl_FragColor = encV(decV(texture2D(u_tex, v_uv)) + u_value * g);
}
`
 
/** Semi-Lagrangian advection + viscous damping of the velocity field. */
const FS_ADVECT = `
precision mediump float;
varying vec2 v_uv;
uniform sampler2D u_vel;
uniform float u_dt;
uniform float u_damp;
${FIELD_GLSL}
void main() {
  vec2 v = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv));
  vec2 back = v_uv - v * u_dt;
  gl_FragColor = encV(decV(texture2D(u_vel, back)) * u_damp);
}
`
 
/** Curl ω = ∂v/∂x − ∂u/∂y — the scalar vorticity map. */
const FS_CURL = `
precision mediump float;
varying vec2 v_uv;
uniform sampler2D u_vel;
uniform vec2 u_texel;
${FIELD_GLSL}
void main() {
  float l = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv - vec2(u_texel.x, 0.0))).y;
  float r = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv + vec2(u_texel.x, 0.0))).y;
  float b = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv - vec2(0.0, u_texel.y))).x;
  float t = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv + vec2(0.0, u_texel.y))).x;
  gl_FragColor = encS((r - l - (t - b)) * 0.5);
}
`
 
/** Confinement force F = ε·(∇|ω|⊥)·ω — restores energy the grid diffuses. */
const FS_VORT = `
precision mediump float;
varying vec2 v_uv;
uniform sampler2D u_vel;
uniform sampler2D u_curl;
uniform vec2 u_texel;
uniform float u_eps;
uniform float u_dt;
${FIELD_GLSL}
void main() {
  float l = decS(texture2D(u_curl, v_uv - vec2(u_texel.x, 0.0)));
  float r = decS(texture2D(u_curl, v_uv + vec2(u_texel.x, 0.0)));
  float b = decS(texture2D(u_curl, v_uv - vec2(0.0, u_texel.y)));
  float t = decS(texture2D(u_curl, v_uv + vec2(0.0, u_texel.y)));
  float c = decS(texture2D(u_curl, v_uv));
  vec2 grad = 0.5 * vec2(abs(t) - abs(b), abs(r) - abs(l));
  grad /= (length(grad) + 1e-4);
  vec2 v = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv)) + u_eps * c * vec2(grad.y, -grad.x) * u_dt;
  gl_FragColor = encV(v);
}
`
 
/** Divergence ∇·V — regions of net in/outflow the projection removes. */
const FS_DIV = `
precision mediump float;
varying vec2 v_uv;
uniform sampler2D u_vel;
uniform vec2 u_texel;
${FIELD_GLSL}
void main() {
  float l = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv - vec2(u_texel.x, 0.0))).x;
  float r = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv + vec2(u_texel.x, 0.0))).x;
  float b = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv - vec2(0.0, u_texel.y))).y;
  float t = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv + vec2(0.0, u_texel.y))).y;
  gl_FragColor = encS((r - l + t - b) * 0.5);
}
`
 
/** One Jacobi iteration of the pressure Poisson solve ∇²p = ∇·V. */
const FS_JACOBI = `
precision mediump float;
varying vec2 v_uv;
uniform sampler2D u_p;
uniform sampler2D u_div;
uniform vec2 u_texel;
${FIELD_GLSL}
void main() {
  float l = decS(texture2D(u_p, v_uv - vec2(u_texel.x, 0.0)));
  float r = decS(texture2D(u_p, v_uv + vec2(u_texel.x, 0.0)));
  float b = decS(texture2D(u_p, v_uv - vec2(0.0, u_texel.y)));
  float t = decS(texture2D(u_p, v_uv + vec2(0.0, u_texel.y)));
  float d = decS(texture2D(u_div, v_uv));
  gl_FragColor = encS((l + r + b + t - d) * 0.25);
}
`
 
/** Projection — subtract ∇p so the field becomes divergence-free. */
const FS_GRAD = `
precision mediump float;
varying vec2 v_uv;
uniform sampler2D u_vel;
uniform sampler2D u_p;
uniform vec2 u_texel;
${FIELD_GLSL}
void main() {
  float l = decS(texture2D(u_p, v_uv - vec2(u_texel.x, 0.0)));
  float r = decS(texture2D(u_p, v_uv + vec2(u_texel.x, 0.0)));
  float b = decS(texture2D(u_p, v_uv - vec2(0.0, u_texel.y)));
  float t = decS(texture2D(u_p, v_uv + vec2(0.0, u_texel.y)));
  vec2 v = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv)) - 0.5 * vec2(r - l, t - b);
  gl_FragColor = encV(v);
}
`
 
/**
 * Display — samples the title texture displaced by the field. A small
 * chromatic fringe on the strong-displacement bands reads as refraction
 * through the liquid surface.
 */
const FS_SHOW = `
precision mediump float;
varying vec2 v_uv;
uniform sampler2D u_tex;
uniform sampler2D u_vel;
uniform float u_disp;
uniform float u_fringe;
${FIELD_GLSL}
void main() {
  vec2 v = decV(texture2D(u_vel, v_uv)) * u_disp;
  vec2 uv = v_uv - v;
  vec4 c = texture2D(u_tex, uv);
  vec4 cr = texture2D(u_tex, uv + v * u_fringe);
  vec4 cb = texture2D(u_tex, uv - v * u_fringe);
  gl_FragColor = vec4(cr.r, c.g, cb.b, c.a);
}
`
 
// ── Session ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 
/** One render target (texture + FBO) of the fluid grid. */
interface FluidTarget {
  tex: WebGLTexture
  fbo: WebGLFramebuffer
}
 
/** Live fluid session parked on `host._fluid`. */
export interface FluidSession {
  /** Overlay canvas inside the shadow root. */
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement
  gl: WebGLRenderingContext
  /** Shader programs keyed by pass name. */
  progs: Record<string, WebGLProgram>
  /** Uniform maps per program — resolved once at init. */
  uni: Record<string, Record<string, WebGLUniformLocation | null>>
  quad: WebGLBuffer
  /** Linker-assigned `a_pos` attribute location — never assume 0. */
  aPos: number
  /** Velocity ping-pong targets. */
  velA: FluidTarget
  velB: FluidTarget
  /** Pressure ping-pong targets. */
  pA: FluidTarget
  pB: FluidTarget
  curlT: FluidTarget
  divT: FluidTarget
  /** Rasterized title texture + its canvas (re-snapshotted on dirty). */
  textCanvas: HTMLCanvasElement
  textTex: WebGLTexture
  simW: number
  simH: number
  /** Padding in css px the canvas extends past the text box. */
  pad: number
  /** Text-box offset inside the canvas (content vs host box). */
  offX: number
  offY: number
  raf: number
  lastT: number
  /** Poll frames burned waiting for the reveal to finish. */
  armPoll: number
  /** Pointer uv + accumulated velocity for the next splat. */
  px: number
  py: number
  pvx: number
  pvy: number
  pointerIn: boolean
  /** Elapsed sim seconds — drives the ambient stirrer orbit. */
  t: number
  /** Host is in the viewport — sim pauses offscreen. */
  visible: boolean
  /** Set by updateDom when chars re-render — triggers a resnapshot. */
  dirty: boolean
  io: IntersectionObserver | null
  ro: ResizeObserver | null
  onLost: EventListener | null
  onMove: EventListener | null
  onLeave: EventListener | null
}
 
// ── GL plumbing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 
/** One RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE target — linear-filtered, edge-clamped. */
function makeTarget(gl: WebGLRenderingContext, w: number, h: number): FluidTarget | null {
  const tex = gl.createTexture()
  const fbo = gl.createFramebuffer()
 
  if (!tex || !fbo) return null
 
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex)
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR)
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR)
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
  gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, w, h, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, null)
  gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo)
  gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex, 0)
 
  return { tex, fbo }
}
 
/** Runs one fullscreen pass into `target` (null → the canvas). */
function pass(
  s: FluidSession,
  name: string,
  target: FluidTarget | null,
  setup: (u: Record<string, WebGLUniformLocation | null>) => void
): void {
  const gl = s.gl
  const prog = s.progs[name]
 
  gl.useProgram(prog)
  gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, target ? target.fbo : null)
 
  if (target) gl.viewport(0, 0, s.simW, s.simH)
  else gl.viewport(0, 0, s.canvas.width, s.canvas.height)
 
  setup(s.uni[name])
  bindQuad(gl, s.quad, s.aPos)
  gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 6)
}
 
/** Binds a field texture to a unit and points the sampler uniform at it. */
function bindTex(
  gl: WebGLRenderingContext,
  loc: WebGLUniformLocation | null,
  tex: WebGLTexture,
  unit: number
): void {
  gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0 + unit)
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex)
 
  if (loc) gl.uniform1i(loc, unit)
}
 
// ── Text snapshot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 
/**
 * Rasterizes the title into the session's offscreen canvas: each char
 * span is drawn at its own on-screen rect with its own computed font
 * and ink, so letter-spacing, links' color and baseline all match the
 * DOM render the fluid surface then replaces visually.
 */
function snapshotText(s: FluidSession, host: DrawText): void {
  const content = host._contentEl
  if (!content) return
 
  // The --fluid class sets char color:transparent — drop it while sampling
  // so the texture captures the true ink. It's restored only if it was on
  // (the raf loop owns the initial stamp when the canvas goes visible), so
  // the DOM never flashes mid-reveal.
  const wasFluid = content.classList.contains(DRAW_TEXT_CLASSES.DRAW_TEXT_FLUID)
 
  content.classList.remove(DRAW_TEXT_CLASSES.DRAW_TEXT_FLUID)
 
  const rect = content.getBoundingClientRect()
 
  if (rect.width < 1 || rect.height < 1) {
    if (wasFluid) content.classList.add(DRAW_TEXT_CLASSES.DRAW_TEXT_FLUID)
 
    s.dirty = true
    return
  }
 
  const hostRect = host.getBoundingClientRect()
  const pad = Math.max(_PAD_MIN, Math.round(rect.height * _PAD_RATIO))
 
  s.pad = pad
  s.offX = rect.left - hostRect.left - pad
  s.offY = rect.top - hostRect.top - pad
 
  const dpr = Math.min(_DPR_CAP, globalThis.devicePixelRatio || 1)
  const cssW = rect.width + 2 * pad
  const cssH = rect.height + 2 * pad
  const w = Math.min(_SNAP_MAX, Math.round(cssW * dpr))
  const h = Math.min(_SNAP_MAX, Math.round(cssH * dpr))
  const scale = w / (cssW * dpr)
 
  s.textCanvas.width = w
  s.textCanvas.height = h
 
  const ctx = s.textCanvas.getContext('2d')
 
  if (!ctx) return
 
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h)
  ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic'
 
  const chars = Array.from(
    content.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(DRAW_TEXT_SELECTORS.DRAW_TEXT_CHAR)
  )
 
  for (const ch of chars) {
    const st = getComputedStyle(ch)
    const r = ch.getBoundingClientRect()
 
    ctx.font = `${st.fontStyle} ${st.fontWeight} ${st.fontSize} ${st.fontFamily}`
    ctx.fillStyle = st.color
 
    // Baseline = box bottom minus the font descent, so glyphs land where
    // the DOM rasterized them rather than on an estimated line.
    const m = ctx.measureText(ch.textContent || ATTR_VALUES.EMPTY)
    const descent =
      (m as TextMetrics & { fontBoundingBoxDescent?: number }).fontBoundingBoxDescent ??
      r.height * 0.2
 
    ctx.fillText(
      ch.textContent || ATTR_VALUES.EMPTY,
      (r.left - rect.left + pad) * dpr * scale,
      (r.bottom - rect.top + pad - descent) * dpr * scale
    )
  }
 
  // Restore the hidden-ink state only if it was active — the loop stamps
  // it on first success when the canvas goes visible.
  if (wasFluid) content.classList.add(DRAW_TEXT_CLASSES.DRAW_TEXT_FLUID)
 
  const gl = s.gl
 
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, s.textTex)
  gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, s.textCanvas)
 
  // Overlay canvas covers the padded text box in host coordinates.
  s.canvas.style.left = `${s.offX}px`
  s.canvas.style.top = `${s.offY}px`
  s.canvas.style.width = `${cssW}px`
  s.canvas.style.height = `${cssH}px`
  s.canvas.width = w
  s.canvas.height = h
 
  // Rebuild the field grid at the same aspect as the canvas.
  s.simH = Math.max(16, Math.min(_SIM_H, Math.round(h / dpr / 4)))
  s.simW = Math.max(16, Math.min(_SIM_W, Math.round((s.simH * w) / Math.max(1, h))))
 
  const targets = [s.velA, s.velB, s.pA, s.pB, s.curlT, s.divT]
 
  for (const t of targets) {
    gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, t.tex)
    gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, s.simW, s.simH, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, null)
  }
 
  clearField(s)
 
  s.dirty = false
}
 
/** Resets the field targets to neutral (encoded zero) via a clear. */
function clearField(s: FluidSession): void {
  const gl = s.gl
 
  gl.clearColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1)
  gl.disable(gl.BLEND)
 
  for (const t of [s.velA, s.velB, s.pA, s.pB, s.curlT, s.divT]) {
    gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, t.fbo)
    gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT)
  }
 
  gl.enable(gl.BLEND)
}
 
// ── Frame pipeline ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 
/** One solver step + display — called by the raf loop each frame. */
function step(s: FluidSession, dt: number): void {
  const gl = s.gl
  const texel: [number, number] = [1 / s.simW, 1 / s.simH]
  const ar = s.canvas.width / Math.max(1, s.canvas.height)
 
  // 1 — Self-advection + damping.
  pass(s, 'advect', s.velB, (u) => {
    bindTex(gl, u['u_vel'], s.velA.tex, 0)
    gl.uniform1f(u['u_dt'], dt)
    gl.uniform1f(u['u_damp'], Math.exp(-_DAMP_PER_S * dt))
  })
 
  ;[s.velA, s.velB] = [s.velB, s.velA]
 
  // 2 — Ambient stirrers: two orbiting injectors stirring tangentially so
  // the surface never settles — cheap continuous forcing.
  const orbit = _STIR_ORBIT
  const w1 = _STIR_OMEGA
  const w2 = _STIR_OMEGA * 0.73
  const stirrers: [number, number, number, number][] = [
    [
      0.5 + orbit * Math.cos(s.t * w1),
      0.5 + orbit * Math.sin(s.t * w1),
      -Math.sin(s.t * w1) * orbit * w1,
      Math.cos(s.t * w1) * orbit * w1,
    ],
    [
      0.5 + orbit * Math.cos(s.t * w2 + 2.1),
      0.5 - orbit * Math.sin(s.t * w2 + 2.1),
      Math.sin(s.t * w2 + 2.1) * orbit * w2,
      -Math.cos(s.t * w2 + 2.1) * orbit * w2,
    ],
  ]
 
  for (const [sx, sy, dx, dy] of stirrers) {
    pass(s, 'splat', s.velB, (u) => {
      bindTex(gl, u['u_tex'], s.velA.tex, 0)
      gl.uniform2f(u['u_point'], sx, sy)
      gl.uniform2f(u['u_value'], dx * _STIR_FORCE, dy * _STIR_FORCE)
      gl.uniform1f(u['u_radius'], _SPLAT_R * 0.5)
      gl.uniform1f(u['u_ar'], ar)
    })
 
    ;[s.velA, s.velB] = [s.velB, s.velA]
  }
 
  // 3 — Pointer impulse: the cursor drags the surface along its motion.
  if (s.pointerIn && (s.pvx !== 0 || s.pvy !== 0)) {
    const vx = s.pvx
    const vy = s.pvy
 
    s.pvx = 0
    s.pvy = 0
 
    pass(s, 'splat', s.velB, (u) => {
      bindTex(gl, u['u_tex'], s.velA.tex, 0)
      gl.uniform2f(u['u_point'], s.px, s.py)
      gl.uniform2f(u['u_value'], vx * _SPLAT_GAIN, vy * _SPLAT_GAIN)
      gl.uniform1f(u['u_radius'], _SPLAT_R * _SPLAT_R)
      gl.uniform1f(u['u_ar'], ar)
    })
 
    ;[s.velA, s.velB] = [s.velB, s.velA]
  }
 
  // 4 — Curl map → confinement force keeps micro-swirls spinning.
  pass(s, 'curl', s.curlT, (u) => {
    bindTex(gl, u['u_vel'], s.velA.tex, 0)
    gl.uniform2f(u['u_texel'], texel[0], texel[1])
  })
 
  pass(s, 'vort', s.velB, (u) => {
    bindTex(gl, u['u_vel'], s.velA.tex, 0)
    bindTex(gl, u['u_curl'], s.curlT.tex, 1)
    gl.uniform2f(u['u_texel'], texel[0], texel[1])
    gl.uniform1f(u['u_eps'], _VORTICITY)
    gl.uniform1f(u['u_dt'], dt)
  })
 
  ;[s.velA, s.velB] = [s.velB, s.velA]
 
  // 5 — Projection: divergence → pressure solve → gradient subtract.
  pass(s, 'div', s.divT, (u) => {
    bindTex(gl, u['u_vel'], s.velA.tex, 0)
    gl.uniform2f(u['u_texel'], texel[0], texel[1])
  })
 
  for (let i = 0; i < _JACOBI; i++) {
    pass(s, 'jacobi', s.pB, (u) => {
      bindTex(gl, u['u_p'], s.pA.tex, 0)
      bindTex(gl, u['u_div'], s.divT.tex, 1)
      gl.uniform2f(u['u_texel'], texel[0], texel[1])
    })
 
    ;[s.pA, s.pB] = [s.pB, s.pA]
  }
 
  pass(s, 'grad', s.velB, (u) => {
    bindTex(gl, u['u_vel'], s.velA.tex, 0)
    bindTex(gl, u['u_p'], s.pA.tex, 1)
    gl.uniform2f(u['u_texel'], texel[0], texel[1])
  })
 
  ;[s.velA, s.velB] = [s.velB, s.velA]
 
  // 6 — Display: displace the title texture by the projected field. The
  // canvas FBO (null) must be bound BEFORE clear — otherwise the clear
  // hits the last sim target and the display pass alpha-blends onto the
  // previous frame, leaving smeared ghosts where text moved away.
  gl.enable(gl.BLEND)
  gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null)
  gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 0)
  gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT)
 
  pass(s, 'show', null, (u) => {
    bindTex(gl, u['u_tex'], s.textTex, 0)
    bindTex(gl, u['u_vel'], s.velA.tex, 1)
    gl.uniform1f(u['u_disp'], _DISP)
    gl.uniform1f(u['u_fringe'], _FRINGE)
  })
}
 
/** RAF loop — rearms on reveal, resnapshots when dirty, steps the sim. */
function loop(s: FluidSession, host: DrawText): void {
  s.raf = requestAnimationFrame(() => loop(s, host))
 
  if (!host._isMounted) return
 
  // The warp only exists once the reveal has finished; while the chars
  // are still drawing (or replaying), the canvas stays empty and the
  // DOM text stays painted — flipping --fluid mid-reveal would hide the
  // title entirely.
  if (!host._hasAnimated) {
    s.armPoll = 0
    s.canvas.style.visibility = ATTR_VALUES.HIDDEN
    host._contentEl?.classList.remove(DRAW_TEXT_CLASSES.DRAW_TEXT_FLUID)
    return
  }
 
  if (s.dirty || s.armPoll === 0) {
    if (s.armPoll > _ARM_POLL_MAX) return
 
    snapshotText(s, host)
    s.armPoll++
 
    if (s.dirty) return
 
    s.canvas.style.visibility = ATTR_VALUES.VISIBLE
    host._contentEl?.classList.add(DRAW_TEXT_CLASSES.DRAW_TEXT_FLUID)
  }
 
  if (!s.visible || document.hidden) return
 
  const now = performance.now()
  const dt = Math.min(0.033, (now - s.lastT) / 1000 || 0.016)
 
  s.lastT = now
  s.t += dt
 
  step(s, dt)
}
 
// ── Arm / disarm ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 
/** Tears the GL session down — context, targets, canvas, listeners. */
export function disarmFluid(host: DrawText): void {
  const s = host._fluid
 
  if (!s) return
 
  host._fluid = null
 
  if (s.raf) cancelAnimationFrame(s.raf)
 
  s.io?.disconnect()
  s.ro?.disconnect()
 
  if (s.onMove) host.removeEventListener(POINTER_EVENTS.POINTERMOVE, s.onMove)
  if (s.onLeave) host.removeEventListener(POINTER_EVENTS.POINTERLEAVE, s.onLeave)
  if (s.onLost) s.canvas.removeEventListener(GL_EVENTS.WEBGL_CONTEXT_LOST, s.onLost)
 
  const gl = s.gl
 
  for (const t of [s.velA, s.velB, s.pA, s.pB, s.curlT, s.divT]) {
    gl.deleteTexture(t.tex)
    gl.deleteFramebuffer(t.fbo)
  }
 
  gl.deleteTexture(s.textTex)
  gl.deleteBuffer(s.quad)
 
  for (const name of Object.keys(s.progs)) gl.deleteProgram(s.progs[name])
 
  const loseExt = gl.getExtension?.('WEBGL_lose_context')
 
  if (loseExt && typeof loseExt.loseContext === TYPE_STRINGS.FUNCTION) loseExt.loseContext()
 
  s.canvas.remove()
 
  host._contentEl?.classList.remove(DRAW_TEXT_CLASSES.DRAW_TEXT_FLUID)
}
 
/**
 * Arms the liquid-distortion surface: builds the overlay canvas + GL
 * pipeline, then starts the raf loop — the loop itself waits for the
 * reveal to finish before rasterizing the title and spinning up the
 * solver. Returns false on any GL failure so the caller can fall back
 * to the char-transform warp.
 */
export function armFluid(host: DrawText): boolean {
  if (!host.shadowRoot || !host._contentEl) return false
  if (host.hasAttribute(COMMON_ATTRS.WARP) === false) return false
  if (store.getters.getReducedMotion?.()) return false
  if (host._fluid) return true // already armed — idempotent
 
  const canvas = document.createElement(HTML_TAGS.CANVAS) as HTMLCanvasElement
 
  canvas.setAttribute(ARIA_ATTRS.ARIA_HIDDEN, ATTR_VALUES.TRUE)
  canvas.className = DRAW_TEXT_CLASSES.DRAW_TEXT_FLUID_CANVAS
 
  const gl = webglContext(canvas, {
    alpha: true,
    premultipliedAlpha: false,
    antialias: false,
    depth: false,
    stencil: false,
  }) as WebGLRenderingContext | null
 
  if (!gl) {
    canvas.remove()
    return false
  }
 
  const progs: Record<string, WebGLProgram> = {}
  const uni: Record<string, Record<string, WebGLUniformLocation | null>> = {}
  const fsFor: Record<string, string> = {
    splat: FS_SPLAT,
    advect: FS_ADVECT,
    curl: FS_CURL,
    vort: FS_VORT,
    div: FS_DIV,
    jacobi: FS_JACOBI,
    grad: FS_GRAD,
    show: FS_SHOW,
  }
  const uniNames: Record<string, string[]> = {
    splat: ['u_tex', 'u_point', 'u_value', 'u_radius', 'u_ar'],
    advect: ['u_vel', 'u_dt', 'u_damp'],
    curl: ['u_vel', 'u_texel'],
    vort: ['u_vel', 'u_curl', 'u_texel', 'u_eps', 'u_dt'],
    div: ['u_vel', 'u_texel'],
    jacobi: ['u_p', 'u_div', 'u_texel'],
    grad: ['u_vel', 'u_p', 'u_texel'],
    show: ['u_tex', 'u_vel', 'u_disp', 'u_fringe'],
  }
 
  let quad: WebGLBuffer | null = null
 
  for (const [name, fs] of Object.entries(fsFor)) {
    const built = createQuadProgram(gl, VS, fs, `drawtext-fluid:${name}`, {
      premultiplied: false,
    })
 
    if (!built) {
      for (const p of Object.values(progs)) gl.deleteProgram(p)
      if (quad) gl.deleteBuffer(quad)
 
      const loseExt = gl.getExtension?.('WEBGL_lose_context')
 
      if (loseExt && typeof loseExt.loseContext === TYPE_STRINGS.FUNCTION) loseExt.loseContext()
 
      canvas.remove()
      return false
    }
 
    progs[name] = built.program
    quad = built.quadBuffer
    uni[name] = {}
 
    gl.useProgram(built.program)
 
    for (const n of uniNames[name]) uni[name][n] = gl.getUniformLocation(built.program, n)
  }
 
  // The attribute location is linker-assigned — every program shares the
  // same VS, so one resolve covers them all; a driver may not pick 0.
  const aPos = gl.getAttribLocation(progs['show'], 'a_pos')
 
  const simW = _SIM_W
  const simH = _SIM_H
  const mk = () => makeTarget(gl, simW, simH)
  const velA = mk()
  const velB = mk()
  const pA = mk()
  const pB = mk()
  const curlT = mk()
  const divT = mk()
  const textTex = gl.createTexture()
 
  if (!velA || !velB || !pA || !pB || !curlT || !divT || !textTex) {
    devWarn('draw-text fluid: target alloc failed — char warp fallback')
    canvas.remove()
    return false
  }
 
  gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, textTex)
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR)
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR)
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
  gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
 
  const s: FluidSession = {
    canvas,
    gl,
    progs,
    uni,
    quad: quad!,
    aPos,
    velA,
    velB,
    pA,
    pB,
    curlT,
    divT,
    textCanvas: document.createElement(HTML_TAGS.CANVAS) as HTMLCanvasElement,
    textTex,
    simW,
    simH,
    pad: 0,
    offX: 0,
    offY: 0,
    raf: 0,
    lastT: performance.now(),
    armPoll: 0,
    px: 0,
    py: 0,
    pvx: 0,
    pvy: 0,
    pointerIn: false,
    t: 0,
    visible: true,
    dirty: true,
    io: null,
    ro: null,
    onLost: null,
    onMove: null,
    onLeave: null,
  }
 
  s.onMove = (e: Event) => {
    const r = s.canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
 
    if (!r.width || !r.height) return
 
    const pe = e as PointerEvent
    const nx = (pe.clientX - r.left) / r.width
    const ny = (pe.clientY - r.top) / r.height
 
    s.pvx += (nx - s.px) / Math.max(0.001, (performance.now() - s.lastT) / 1000)
    s.pvy += (ny - s.py) / Math.max(0.001, (performance.now() - s.lastT) / 1000)
    s.px = nx
    s.py = ny
    s.pointerIn = true
  }
 
  s.onLeave = () => {
    s.pointerIn = false
  }
 
  host.addEventListener(POINTER_EVENTS.POINTERMOVE, s.onMove)
  host.addEventListener(POINTER_EVENTS.POINTERLEAVE, s.onLeave)
 
  // Pause the solver offscreen — the title isn't visible anyway.
  s.io = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
    s.visible = !!entry?.isIntersecting
  })
 
  s.io.observe(host)
